items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: He used to play a flute. He used to wear a cape. He was a great big tall black fella.

ctx.x: Who was he? That was the fellow. He used to play a flute. He used to wear a cape. He was a great big tall black fella. He looked like a big elephant. And he had Bigfoot. They called him Bigfoot Willis. And he used to go around and blow a flute around Decatur Street.
How did you get your nickname, Booker T?
